scheme: MMDA Unified Vehicular Volume Reduction Program (UVVRP) - number coding
legal_basis: MMDA Regulation No. 96-005, as amended; MMDA Resolution No. 22-14, s. 2022
exempt_vehicles: Vehicles carrying essential and/or perishable goods
notes: Metro Manila (NCR). Coding applies on weekdays except holidays, 7:00-10:00 AM and 5:00-8:00 PM, based on the last digit of the plate. Day keys are ISO weekdays (1=Monday). The MMDA release lists no exempt roads; on secondary roads the number-coding ordinances of each LGU prevail, so city rules may differ. Source: MMDA press release PR-22-08-069 (Aug. 11, 2022); no later MMDA change found as of 2026-10-09 (see docs/SOURCES.md).
